senses.sense_definition: A formal addition or change to a constitution or a legal document.

examples.text: The First <w>Amendment</w> protects the right to free speech for all citizens.

senses.sense_definition: A change made to improve something or to correct a fault.

examples.text: The editor suggested an <w>amendment</w> to the final chapter to improve the flow.

target_lang_translations.ru: Редактор предложил <w>исправление</w> в последнюю главу, чтобы улучшить повествование.
target_lang_translations.tr: Editör, akışı iyileştirmek için son bölümde bir <w>düzeltme</w> yapılmasını önerdi.

examples.text: He made an <w>amendment</w> to his lifestyle after the doctor warned him about his health.

target_lang_translations.ru: Он внес <w>изменения</w> в свой образ жизни после того, как врач предупредил его о здоровье.

target_lang_translations.es: Hizo una <w>modificación</w> en su estilo de vida después de que el médico le advirtiera sobre su salud.

target_lang_translations.pt: Depois de ter sido avisado pelo médico sobre a sua saúde, fez um <w>ajuste</w> ao seu estilo de vida.
